page.layout: One page of text in a single column. No margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Top paragraph continues from the previous page. Then centred headings and paragraphs. No catchword, signature or footnote.

main_text.p: lis, is patri arrogato in defuncti filii successione præ-fertur: Sin vero cum Arrogatore patre, extincto na-turali, concurrant fratres & sorores utrinque conjun-cti ipsi defuncto, inter illos omnes fit successio in capita. Gloss super verbis, Aliæ personæ. §. mortuo. instit. de adquisit. per adrogat.
main_text.head: Sequentes Regulæ de successione parentum spuriorum sunt ob-servandæ.
Prima Regula.
main_text.p: Pater filio spurio nulla in re succedit, cum is plane sit incertus. l. si spurius. ff. unde cognati.
main_text.head: Secunda Regula.
main_text.p: Mater vero, licet sit illustris, aliosque naturales & legitimos simul habeat, nihilominus filio suo spurio mortuo ab intestato succedere potest. §. final. & ibi Angel. inst. de SC. Tertyllian. Verum Accursius in d. §. final. diversum tenet, sed male. Unde a Doctoribus communiter reprehenditur, inquit Schneidewyn[?].

head.i: De successione parentum, ex damnato coitu susceptorum, hæc tenenda est Regula.

main_text.p: Neque pater, neque mater, nec ulli alii ascendentes li-beris ex damnato coitu susceptis succedere possunt. Authen. ex complexu. C. de incest. & inutilib. nuptiis.

head.i: De successione parentum spiritualium hæc notanda est Regula.

main_text.p: Sicut filii spirituales non succedunt parentibus spiritualibus: ita econtra, Parentes spirituales, non succedunt filiis spiritualibns.

p.i: Secundus gradus ab intestato succedendi bre-viter expositus est.

page.notes: The running head is printed in spaced capitals; the u in IURIS is a consonant, so it is written IVRIS. The name at the end of the Schneidewin paragraph is partly worn and was read as Schneidewyn[?]. The printed spelling "spiritualibns" is a printing error and is left as printed. The printed form "filij" was changed to "filii" because the letter is a vowel. A stray ink mark at the foot of the page is not text and was left out.
